title: REQ · Tab and arrow keys write the focused object id to the store
summary: Keyboard focus moves call setFocusedObject with the newly focused id
description: Context: onKeyDown calls moveFocus then emits focusChange only. Desired behavior: after moveFocus, the scene calls useGameStore.getState().setFocusedObject(id) for Tab, Shift+Tab and arrow keys. Expected result: the store focusedObjectId matches the scene's focused object after every move. Why: store becomes the owner of focus.
acceptance_criteria: Given objects [bookshelf] and Tab pressed, when handled, then the store focusedObjectId is 'bookshelf'.
Given Shift+Tab or ArrowLeft pressed, when handled, then setFocusedObject is called with the focused object id.
Given the focusChange event, when a move happens, then it is still emitted with the same id.
definition_of_done: Store write happens on every focus-moving key
